setup.title: Clone the projects and scaffolds
setup.description: Place dependencies, the frontend workspace and the generator under ~/workspace/sparrow. Place the backend scaffold directly under ~/workspace.
setup.note: sparrow-example and sparrow are sibling directories. react-next-admin lives inside sparrow-js. Node.js is only required to run the frontend.

setup.title: Install dependencies in order
setup.description: Install the core framework first, followed by the integration starter, file services and authentication framework. Build sparrow-coder last.
setup.note: sparrow-shell provides infra-bom and sparrow-bom, so it must be installed first.

setup.title: Initialize the database
setup.description: Start MySQL, create the sparrow database and import the project configuration, table configuration and example table scripts.

setup.title: Configure the workspace and services
setup.description: Edit coder-main-spring-boot/src/main/resources/application.properties to set your workspace paths, database connection and Redis settings.
setup.note: These paths use macOS conventions. Replace the username, database password and service addresses with your local values.

setup.title: Configure frontend static resources
setup.description: Edit coder-main-spring-boot/src/main/configs/dev.properties so the generator can load its frontend static resources.
setup.note: Replace your_home_path with your actual home directory and ensure the path matches the location of sparrow-js.

setup.title: Start the generator
setup.description: The dev environment uses port 8888 by default. Open the home page and sign in to start configuring projects.
setup.note: Home: http://localhost:8888; API docs: http://localhost:8888/doc.html; Druid monitor: http://localhost:8888/druid (default username and password: druid).

workflow.title: Define a project and download its scaffold
workflow.description: In Project Configuration, set the project names, business package, frontend project name, module prefix, architecture and scaffold. Configure internationalization and a parent module if needed, then use zip-download to download your backend and frontend business project.

workflow.title: Build and run your business project
workflow.description: Run mvn clean package -Dmaven.test.skip=true for the backend, then start the module artifact with java -jar. In the generated frontend directory, run npm install and npm run dev. Build and start the two applications separately.

workflow.title: Write PO classes in your own package
workflow.description: In your generated business project, use com.sparrow.coder.po.Department (parent) and com.sparrow.coder.po.UserExample (child) as references. Copy them into your own PO package, such as com.yourcompany.po, and change the package declaration. Describe metadata with @Table and @Column; link the parent table with @ListDatasource(type = ListDatasourceType.TABLE, params = "t_department"). Do not generate business code directly from the official example classes.

workflow.title: Generate backend and frontend code
workflow.description: Return to sparrow-coder, select a table and click Generate Code (/coder/generate.json). PO metadata and templates produce the DAO, Domain, Adapter and Infrastructure layers, plus frontend lists and forms. No AI is involved.

workflow.title: Rebuild and run the generated code
workflow.description: Return to your business project, rebuild and restart the backend and frontend to activate the generated code. Continue implementing your business logic on top of the generated architecture.

workflow.title: Customize the interface with column configuration
workflow.description: Use column_configs in t_table_config to control visible columns, filters, row menus and status commands. Parent-child relationships can automatically produce dropdowns or association controls.

faq.question: The build cannot find infra-bom or sparrow-* dependencies?
faq.answer: Confirm that all dependency repositories are cloned, then run mvn clean install in the order shown in the setup guide. Install sparrow-shell first because the other modules depend on its POMs.

faq.question: The application cannot connect to the database?
faq.answer: Check that MySQL is running, the sparrow database exists, and the connection URL, username and password in application.properties are correct.

faq.question: Frontend static resources return 404?
faq.answer: Check workspace and frontend_project_root in application.properties, as well as physical_resource in dev.properties. Each path must resolve to the correct local directory.

faq.question: Can I generate business code directly from the official PO examples?
faq.answer: No. Department and UserExample are references. Copy them into your business project's own PO package and update the package declaration before generation. The generator uses your PO metadata and does not require AI.
